_comment: Fundraising proposal for Jetstream Venture Fund (Michael Shufeldt, Doug Sylvester). From the Oct 16 2026 strategy call with Michael (Matt). Evergreen fund; goal is moving the average check from $5–10K retail to $50K+ allocators. Three partner profiles (Michael, John, Doug) for $3,000/month, four-month term, no opt-out.

cards.label: THE GOAL
cards.text: Raise the average check into Jetstream Venture Fund. Most investors today come in at $5–10K; the goal is a repeatable weekly flow of $50K–$500K+ allocators: family offices, high-net-worth individuals and seasoned angels, the tier between retail and institutions. Evergreen with no close date, so every new allocator compounds toward a $30M fund.

cards.label: THE PLAN
cards.text: Three partner profiles (Michael’s, John’s and Doug’s), run end to end by ThinkFISH in your voices, each aimed at the network it already speaks to: military and aviation, physicians, and legal professionals, alongside family offices and angels. Every meeting pre-qualified to your $50K minimum and approved by you.

cards.label: THE INVESTMENT
cards.text: $3,000 per month, flat, for all three profiles. Four-month committed term. No setup fee, no success fee, no commission, no transaction involvement.

band.label: WHAT TO EXPECT
band.text: Outreach live within two weeks of kickoff. First qualified investor conversations in weeks three and four, building to a steady 3–6 qualified meetings per week across the three profiles from month two, with weekly reporting by profile and segment. One honest note: larger allocators move more slowly than the $5–10K investors you close today. Diligence on a fund takes time, and many will start with a test allocation and add as they watch the share price, exactly as your current investors have. We’d rather you hear that from us now.

gap.narrative: The fund is proven where it counts: when someone interested gets a conversation with you, they almost always invest, and existing investors keep adding as the share price climbs. What’s missing isn’t the close, it’s the at-bats with larger checkwriters. In-person events and referrals work but don’t repeat, and family offices are harangued by fundraisers all day, so cold calls, email and automated LinkedIn tools never reach them.
gap.principle: At $5,000 a check, it takes thousands of investors to build a $30M fund. The variable you control is how many $50K+ conversations reach your calendars every week, from a partner the investor already has reason to trust.
rows: Plenty of small checks, too few large ones. Phone, email and LinkedIn all came back “tough”; the automated tools you tried produced nothing.
It takes a lot of $5,000 investors to be a $30M fund. Every allocator at the right tier is worth ten to a hundred retail checks.
Partners spending their time on events and referrals that close well but can’t be scheduled, instead of on deals and portfolio companies.
Without a repeatable channel, you never learn whether bigger checkwriters want this fund, or whether your sample to date was simply biased.

segments.name: Single-Family Offices & Funds of Funds
segments.why: The tier between individuals and institutions you named. A $50K allocation is routine for them, and an evergreen fund with no carry suits long-horizon capital.

segments.name: JOHN  ·  Physician & Healthcare Investors
segments.why: Doctors and healthcare executives with health tech, medtech or biotech exposure. A physician-founder’s profile is the one they’ll answer.

segments.name: MICHAEL  ·  Military & Aviation Investors
segments.why: Airline and military pilots, veterans and defense professionals. A shared background is the strongest foot in the door, and the fund holds defense deals.

segments.name: DOUG  ·  Attorneys & Professional HNW
segments.why: Law firm partners and high-earning professionals in their 30s–50s looking to diversify beyond public markets into venture.

segments.name: Seasoned Angels & Syndicate Leads
segments.why: Experienced investors who value per-deal exits, the tax treatment, access to your deal flow and the option to syndicate alongside the fund.

icp.note: These segments are our starting point. A fuller outline of investor targets, including check sizes, geographies, exclusions and which partner leads each, will be planned with you during onboarding.

architecture.title: Three Partners, Three Networks
architecture.subtitle: HOW ONE CAMPAIGN USES EACH PARTNER’S CREDIBILITY

cards.label: JOHN  ·  PHYSICIANS
cards.text: John’s profile carries the fund to doctors and healthcare investors. A physician-founder with a strong LinkedIn presence and decades in healthcare speaks their language, and the fund’s health tech, medtech and biotech holdings need no explaining.

cards.label: MICHAEL  ·  MILITARY
cards.text: Michael’s profile carries the fund to airline and military pilots, veterans and defense professionals, plus the family offices and angels in the core ICP. Shared service is one of the strongest openers we see, and the network is largely untapped by the fund so far.

cards.label: DOUG  ·  LEGAL & HNW
cards.text: Doug’s profile carries the fund to attorneys and high-earning professionals diversifying beyond public markets. Each profile has its own audience, scripts and scorecard, so a physician never receives the pitch written for a pilot.

band.label: WHY ONE RETAINER COVERS ALL THREE
band.text: The engine is shared: one dedicated account manager, one CRM, one weekly review, one report split by partner and segment. On top of outreach, the fund is retargeted to our 10k+ opt-in investor network and featured twice in Startup Deal Desk, our 84k-subscriber investor newsletter. The partner-to-segment mapping is our starting assumption; Chris’s profile can carry a science and research segment later if the data says it should.

band.label: WHAT “QUALIFIED” MEANS, AND THE HONEST TIMELINE
band.text: A qualified meeting is a family office, high-net-worth individual or angel with a verified investing history, who passed scoring and human review, confirmed on booking that they meet your $50K minimum, and whose briefing you approved. Larger allocators take longer to decide than retail investors, and many start with a test allocation before adding more. We’ll fill your calendars quickly; the pace of capital depends on your process and their diligence.

cards.label: OUTREACH VOLUME
cards.text: We aim to send 600–800 InMails and 600–800 connection invites per profile every month from Michael’s, John’s and Doug’s accounts once fully warmed up. Every touch scored and hand-reviewed first.

cards.label: QUALIFIED MEETINGS
cards.unit: per week at steady state (month 2 onward)
cards.text: Conservatively 1–2 per profile per week once calibrated, every one at or above your $50K minimum. Not a guarantee, but the range we deliver consistently.

cards.label: TIME TO FIRST MEETINGS
cards.unit: weeks from kickoff to first booked calls
cards.text: Weeks one and two are setup: ICP, audiences, scripts and warming three profiles. Live outreach starts in week three, and the first replies and bookings follow within days.

columns.label: WEEKS 1-2  ·  EARLY NOV
columns.title: Setup & Calibration
bullets: Interviews: Michael, John, Doug
Three audiences, one per profile
Profiles branded to Jetstream
Scripts approved in your voices

columns.label: WEEKS 3-4  ·  MID NOV
columns.title: First Live Outreach
bullets: Live on all three profiles
First replies, first booked meetings
Startup Deal Desk feature #1

columns.label: MONTH 2  ·  DECEMBER
columns.title: Steady Flow
bullets: Steady weekly flow, $50K+ only
Targeting tightened on real replies
Report: which segment writes checks

columns.label: MONTH 3  ·  JANUARY
columns.title: Prove-Out & Scale
bullets: Three months of data by segment
Volume shifted to what converts
Plan: add Chris, or new segments

band.label: THE JANUARY REVIEW
band.text: By January you’ll have three months of real numbers by partner and segment: who replies, who books, and who allocates. That answers the question you raised on the call, whether bigger checkwriters have an appetite for the fund. Month four puts the budget behind the winning segments, and the decision to continue or scale (add Chris’s profile for science investors) gets made on data.

bullets: Three LinkedIn profiles (Michael, John, Doug), fully managed
Full campaign execution, end to end
Outreach, inbox management & follow-ups
Qualification to your $50K minimum & pre-call briefings
The Reef retargeting & two Startup Deal Desk features

CRM, weekly reporting, A/B testing & optimization

buys.label: WHAT THAT BUYS
bullets: Three partner profiles for the price of two: John’s profile was added so physicians hear from a physician
Three distinct networks (military, medicine, law) worked at once, with results reported by segment
One dedicated account manager, one CRM and one weekly report across all three partners
A clear answer by month three on which investor tier and segment actually allocates to the fund
Interest below your $50K minimum isn’t wasted: it’s routed to a separate group track you can pitch at once

cards.label: 1  ·  REVIEW
cards.text: Michael, share this with Doug ahead of next week’s call. We’ll run it as a Q&A: bring every question that comes out of Doug’s review of other fundraising tools, and we’ll answer them directly.

cards.label: 2  ·  SIGN & KICK OFF
cards.text: We send the services agreement the same day you say yes. Onboarding interviews with Michael, John and Doug start that week, and we connect the three LinkedIn profiles to our system.

cards.label: 3  ·  FIRST MEETINGS
cards.text: All three profiles are live within two weeks of kickoff. The first qualified investor conversations land on your calendars in weeks three and four, then build to a steady weekly rhythm through December and into the January review.

band.label: WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU
band.text: Connect Michael’s, John’s and Doug’s LinkedIn accounts to our system (no passwords or login credentials required). Share the fund’s current offering materials, any investor lists and past conversations, and your existing investors so we exclude them. A 60-minute onboarding interview with each partner. A Calendly link for each of you, and a do-not-contact list. That’s it. We handle the rest.

deliverables.text: 600–800 InMails and 600–800 connection invites per profile every month, from Michael’s, John’s and Doug’s accounts, in your voices, once fully warmed up. Every InMail credit in your Sales Navigator plans gets used.
